task: Draft a short, restrained product-introduction email for a small editorial team considering a shared inbox. Include a subject line and a clear demo-request action. All product details are fictional. Explain the supplied functions without adding urgency, pricing, customer proof, or quantified benefits.

facts.text: The fictional product Thread Tray organizes shared-inbox messages by owner.
An assignee can see a handoff note beside the message.
A demo can be requested at https://example.org/thread-tray/demo.
Submitting the demo request does not automatically create an account.
The packet provides no price or measured performance result.

forbidden_additions: A free trial, subscription price, discount, or expiring offer.
Guaranteed time savings, sales improvements, or customer testimonials.
A claim that the demo request immediately provisions an account.
preserve: A modest feature-led introduction for readers evaluating a tool.
The difference between requesting a demo and creating an account.
